repository.name: @webex/plugin-teams
repository.purpose: Public plugin registered as webex.teams that manages Webex teams through the Webex REST API teams resource (catalog service hydra): create POSTs a team, get takes a team object or id and resolves one team, list resolves a webex-core Page, and update PUTs the whole team object. Each call sends one request through webex.request and resolves what the service returns; the plugin checks no argument, emits no event, defines no delete, and caches or persists nothing.

commands.unit-test: [NEEDS HUMAN INPUT] -- package.json defines no test:unit script and the package has no test/unit directory; its only spec, test/integration/spec/teams.js, runs only under test:browser:broken, which currently bundles nothing. Add a unit suite and script before recording a command here.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/plugin-teams package entry
public_interfaces.audience: SDK bundles (webex, webex-node) and applications that build their own webex instance
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package registers Teams as public plugin 'teams' with no config; the first registration of the name wins. The default export Teams is the only export.

public_interfaces.name: webex.teams methods
public_interfaces.audience: applications and the integration spec of plugin-team-memberships
public_interfaces.notes: Each method sends one hydra teams request. get takes a team object or an id and resolves body.items when present, else the body; list resolves a webex-core Page; update sends the whole object as the body. get and update read team.id synchronously, so a missing argument throws a TypeError instead of rejecting. There is no delete method and no event.

public_interfaces.name: package scripts
public_interfaces.notes: build runs build:src, which writes dist. There is no test:unit script and no unit test. test:browser:broken (commands.browser-test) runs karma over test/integration/spec but bundles nothing today (no case run, exit 0). The aggregate test script runs test:style, then exits 1 because test:unit is not defined (it also names test:integration and test:browser, which are not defined either); it is deliberately not a manifest command.

negative_guidance.why: Callers receive the service response as it is today (MOD-002 to MOD-005).

negative_guidance.why: They identify users' teams; the plugin logs nothing today.
